WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT date_dim.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND date_dim.d_year IN (2000,2000+1,2000+2)
),
store_filtered AS (
    SELECT store.s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE store.s_county IN ('Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County')
),
household_filtered AS (
    SELECT household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND CASE WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN household_demographics.hd_dep_count / household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count ELSE NULL END > 1
),
dj AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk, count(*) cnt
    FROM date_dim_filtered d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_filtered st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN household_filtered hh ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hh.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c_last_name ASC
